summary: InfiniGen manages the KV cache for LLM inference by offloading it to CPU memory and prefetching only the tokens the model's attention pattern will actually need. This figure shows how, during the prefill stage, InfiniGen turns a full query/key matrix into a small set of partial weights. Starting from a heatmap of the absolute sum of the skewed query and key matrices, a 'Partial Weight Index Generation' box first sums each column into a single row of magnitudes (step 1, Column Sum), then keeps only the K columns with the largest sums (step 2, Top-K), here yielding indices 3, 6 and 7. Those indices are then used as a column mask on a second matrix, producing 'Selected Partial Weights' where only the chosen columns are kept (highlighted blue) and the rest are left pale. The two numbered steps make the whole index-selection algorithm traceable in one small diagram.
